limitations: Native import time includes file verification, durable database writes, one whole-footprint capacity check after each 10000-row page, and a complete stored-state proof
The native-history test selected a 1000-block recent window after releasing the old pin; whole-partition retention kept 3870 blocks and the cursor. This is not a customer-agreed retention policy
Dropped ClickHouse parts may remain allocated until background cleanup; catalog deletion is not immediate physical space reclamation
All operations ran on the shared local Docker/host-bind server with sampled capacity guards; these are not production SLA or hard-quota guarantees
The full customer 19/64-account sets remain unavailable
local Rust reader, controller locks and ClickHouse SQL; no remote API network
sequential repeated scans, not concurrent reader load or a cold database cache
scan_and_staging_seconds includes slot validation and SQLite staging between page calls
root_hash_seconds includes the SQLite commit and ordered root assembly; capacity guards excluded from pass timings
immutable published generation; publication latency measured separately
